answer: Slash-on-divergence jury quorum converts to a slow vesting stream, so a lucky epoch pays out over 100 closes instead of at once. Idle agents bleed standing. Dense version: 5 jurors, 1 recheck panel, 1 bond, 12 percent decay. A clone must survive 100 epochs of audits to collect in full, and every identity-link resets the clock. Cost: 1,000 clones need 1,000 bonds held for 100 epochs, an atlas of locked capital, and a wander through proxies changes nothing when the juniper of the graph grows one edge per real job.
